$comment: DERIVED, not verbatim. Written by this library from the prose of the W3C Recommendation Verifiable Credential Data Integrity 1.0 (REC-vc-data-integrity-20250515), which prints no JSON Schema, CDDL or ABNF of its own (README.md gives the search). Source .cache/w3c-vc-data-integrity-1-0.bin, sha256 ba5c4baf13fe3bab3ebd95ab6650d6fe83720e254b383bb444b4fbbae7bcf4fe; quotations are cut from its rendering .cache/w3c-vc-data-integrity-1-0.txt, sha256 2b7725f80e138ef943eff25050eee6a62f8887762ca9e1e03867c55ea5647beb, and cite its line numbers (L). LEVELS: the root and every anchor not ending in -should state MUST and MUST NOT rules, so a failure there is non-conformance; an anchor ending in -should adds SHOULD statements and includes the root by reference, so a failure there is a warning. MAY statements are never constraints: a leniency a MAY grants has its own anchor, named for the leniency. A constraint marked INFERRED is a reading this library made, not a statement of the source; one marked OUTSIDE-SOURCE comes from a document the source names and is not this source's. Rule ids (P-nn, S-nn, V-nn, E-nn, O-nn, M-nn) are those of rules.derived.yaml. INSTANCE: a JSON object that carries digestMultibase, a resource-integrity protected object (section 2.3). ROOT = MUST. The value's inner form, a Multibase-encoded Multihash, is not checked by a JSON Schema beyond being a non-empty string; check-schemas.derived.py decodes the one example (Example 8) and reports the result. Multibase and Multihash are defined by Controlled Identifiers v1.0 (OUTSIDE-SOURCE). O-02 w3c-vc-data-integrity-1-0#R-0022: “an implementer MAY include a property named digestMultibase in any object that includes an id property” (L388) A MAY. The dependentRequired reads its scope as a limit: digestMultibase appears only beside an id. INFERRED; the sentence permits and does not forbid. Drop dependentRequired to read it as a permission only.

digestMultibase.$comment: O-01 w3c-vc-data-integrity-1-0#R-0023: “If present, the digestMultibase value MUST be a single string value, or an list of string values, each of which is a Multibase-encoded Multihash value.” (L388) A string, or a non-empty array of strings. Two characters at least (a Multibase header and one digit of data): INFERRED. The source says an list, a typo kept in the quotation.
